subject: Merging .bin files to read into GGIR

messages.author: a718d60f4623162f
messages.subject: Merging .bin files to read into GGIR
parts:
Hi all!

We have had a few participants in our research study wear a geneactiv for a few days (before the watch has broke/run out of battery) and we have had to send them another one to finish the period of data collection (meaning we have two bin files for one participant). Has anyone had any luck merging two .bin files together to put through GGIR? If so, how did you go about it? Or is there another way of dealing with this in the code?

Thanks!

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Merging .bin files to read into GGIR
parts:
Hi Jessica,

GGIR facilitates this with parameter maxRecordingInterval
For example, if you set this to 24, GGIR will append all recordings with the same participant ID that have a gap in between them of less than 24 hours.

The number of recordings to be merged is not limited, so technically you can have a whole year of recordings, which are then merged into one recording. Because this would be too much data to merge at raw level the merging happens at epoch level in GGIR part 1.

Best, Vincent
